decisions.reason: The trommel screen is a relaunch of the existing BASIC 518 and directly builds on the firm's screening knowledge, so it can interpret early results and improve it.
Mobile high-speed flail shredding is related to the firm's existing size-reduction and mobile machinery knowledge, enabling learning from early results.
Although only mentioned on the website, mobile high-speed grinding is close to the firm's existing processing and size-reduction capabilities.
Stationary electric fine shredding builds on the firm's stationary shredder and electrical drive knowledge, so early results can be assimilated.
The green-waste grinder leverages the firm's grinder and biomass-related knowledge, supporting interpretation and improvement.
Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are a core extension of existing shredding expertise, so the firm can learn from and develop the product.
